fields.summary_ko.0: SpaceX (SPCX) share price rising due to Anthropic (ANT) IPO success, with Wall Street average target price of $267.76 showing approximately 86.6% upside from current price.
fields.summary_ko.1: Anthropic is SpaceX's largest AI customer representing more than one-third of Q3 revenue, with SpaceX leasing computing capacity linked to Colossus supercomputer.
fields.summary_ko.2: Following Starship Flight 15 success, Citi raised target price from $240 to $280 with long-term target of $900, and BofA set target price at $275 indicating more than 90% upside.
